messages:
Maya Lopez: Quick ask 1: we're prepping a 15-min technical preflight to send to three renewal-risk customers. Need a compact, customer-facing checklist that their engs can fill out about caching, batching, and streaming. Want it precise so AMs can triage before the call. Ideas?

Arjun Rao: Keep it form-like. Short fields + 3 validation steps they can run (curl + quick perf check + example payload). Also add a small 'what to change now' section: batch_size, cache_ttl, enable_streaming toggle.

Lena Kim: Suggest thresholds: cache hit% < 30% = immediate win; p95 > 600ms = risky; error rate > 1% = escalate. Recommend streaming for responses that take >400ms on average.

Maya Lopez: Good. Also capture renewal signals in the form: decreased usage week-over-week, increase in latency compared to baseline, repeated billing disputes. AMs want a one-line recommended next step per signal (e.g., open SRE ticket, schedule optimization call, enable warm-pool).

ops_bot: Tip: run `/collect-metrics <account>` to auto-fill cache_hit and latency fields into the form.

Arjun Rao: Short validation snippets for customers: 
1) Streaming smoke test:
```
curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Prefer: streaming=1" \
  -d '{"input":"test","stream":true}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/chat
```
2) Quick p95 check (Linux):
```
for i in {1..20}; do time curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate; done
```

Connor Blake: Here's a tiny customer-fill template (one paragraph per line so AM can paste into email):
---
ACCOUNT PREFLIGHT (please complete before the call)
- Account name:
- Eng contact (name/email):
- Endpoint(s) impacted:
- Cache strategy (prefix/response/shared):
- Observed cache TTL(s) and headers:
- Cache hit % (7d):
- Current batch_size (min/max):
- Streaming enabled? (y/n):
- p95 latency (24h):
- Error rate (24h):
- Recent config changes (14d):
- Priority flows (1-3):
---

Lena Kim: Add a tiny recommended-changes checklist they can tick off: 
- Increase cache_ttl to 3600s for stable prompts
- Switch repetitive prompts to prefix caching
- Reduce batch_size to 1-4 for interactive low-latency flows
- Enable streaming for long-running gen (>400ms)
- If bursty traffic, enable warm-pools / autoscale burst rather than giant batch sizes

Maya Lopez: Perfect. Arjun, can you assemble into a one-pager PDF and a plain-text email snippet? Try to keep the whole thing <1 page. Tag me when done.

Arjun Rao: On it. I'll post drafts here in ~2 hours and attach auto-fill script for `/collect-metrics`.

ops_bot: Created ticket CS-HOT-1221 to track the artifact and follow-ups. Assigned to Arjun Rao.

Connor Blake: I'll add short node + python validation examples to the repo once Arjun posts the draft.

Maya Lopez: Thanks team, this will make our renewal outreach much smoother.
